$comment: Manifest for app/data/geo. Generated alongside the geometry; see README.md. Ids and file names are stable.

files.use: base map coastline (all 10m map units dissolved)
large lakes, drawn in the sea colour over land

notes.ids: Every geometry carries both a TopoJSON `id` and `properties.id`; both are the unit slug.
notes.winding: d3 spherical convention (exterior rings clockwise). Safe for geoPath, geoArea, geoContains and clipped projections.
notes.tiny: units.index.json marks 101 units `tiny` (area < 6000 km2). Draw a minimum-size marker at `point` for those, or they vanish at world zoom.
notes.bbox: [west, south, east, north]; west > east for units crossing the antimeridian (e.g. fiji, new-zealand).
notes.runtime: Use app/vendor/geo.js — it exports feature(), mergeArcs(), loadUnits() and unionUnits().
